title: The Industry Map: AWS Certification Pathway
subtitle: The broader cloud ecosystem mirrors this structure. Whether AWS or Azure, the industry demands a proven progression from Foundational Practitioner to Machine Learning Specialty.

categories.label: FOUNDATIONAL
categories.desc: 6 months of fundamental AWS Cloud and industry knowledge

categories.label: ASSOCIATE
categories.desc: 1 year of experience solving problems and implementing solutions using the AWS Cloud

categories.label: PROFESSIONAL
categories.desc: 2 years of experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting solutions using the AWS Cloud

categories.label: SPECIALTY
categories.desc: 5+ years technical AWS Cloud experience in the Specialty domain as specified in the exam
